`static-visual-v1.glb` is a synthetic artifact generated by the asset-server's `examples/static_visual_fixture.rs` at commit `b20db539736b9478cb32967fa8b29ff9a3b14ca5` (PR #60). It contains authored asymmetric geometry, a one-pixel PNG, two instances, full vertex colors and a textured MASK material. No native game assets are included.

The embedded bake revision hashes the fixture source plus its policy token. Tests compare decoded semantics, not the writer's report: server bounds are `[-3, -7, 2]` to `[16.44179, 13, 6.5]`. Provenance names and generator text do not determine asset behavior; the explicit artifact header does.
